title: Malicious code in @leadstack/crm-connect (npm)
description: The npm package @leadstack/crm-connect is a malicious package that masquerades as a CRM connector but installs a persistent backdoor on the host system. Its postinstall script downloads configuration from an unsecure HTTP endpoint, installs a concealed agent with root privileges, and sets up a systemd service disguised as legitimate software. This service connects to a remote Telegram channel, allowing the attacker full remote code execution on the infected host. The package versions 1.0.15, 1.0.18 through 1.0.21, and 1.0.30 are affected.
